source.authors: Pretorius HS, Ferreira N, Burger MC
source.title: A computer tomography-based anthropomorphic study of forearm osteology: implications for prosthetic design

cohort_limitations: 97 adult clinical scans, predominantly male, single geographic clinical population and single measurer; not an ANSUR stature-conditioned target.

measurement_definitions.radius_length: Methods use wrist midpoint to radial-head centre; Table I labels head centre to distal-radius centre. Not radiale-to-stylion.
measurement_definitions.styloid_length: Figure1a uses a periarticular projected height, not a 3D radiocarpal centre-to-stylion vector.
measurement_definitions.radial_head_height: Figure4b measures head height, not superior lateral rim to humeroradial articular centre.

source_internal_discrepancy.resolution: UNRESOLVED; neither interval selected for model targets

inference: Do not halve head height or substitute styloid projected height for missing model-specific offsets. Derivation and frame correspondence remain unverified.
next_action: Seek a source identifying articular-centre and palpable-landmark coordinates in one calibrated frame, with uncertainty and population applicability.
